title: Confession and Will
author: Hazel Crane
blurb: Zephyrine Yarrow, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
